upstreamSurface.note: The pinned runtime, the evaluator and the source-first receipt pattern were built there; this house adopted them rather than reinventing them. Assertion semantics now come from the same place as a content-addressed engine release (claim-v1, 2026.9.12).

files.note: Served unminified; the served file is its own corresponding source. Was byte-identical to the upstream evaluator, which junghanacs.com froze as engine module cell-v1 (sha256 33595f963be56964bb8544401eec19b7d65c5193816826c2da6f372a6c9234f6). This house then moved its assertion semantics out of this file and into claim-v1, so the bytes now differ from cell-v1 by that delegation.

In-sentence evaluator: fills <output data-eval> with the value recomputed in the reader's browser, and leaves the author's claim in place when it cannot. Asserts through claim-v1 in scalar-exact mode. Served unminified; the served file is its own corresponding source.

Assertion semantics only; evaluation and rendering stay separate. Fetched from the upstream immutable engine shelf and verified against the sha256 the shelf publishes in its own manifest. Conformance fixtures: /eval/engine/releases/2026.9.12/conformance-v1.<sha>.json upstream.
